title: Italian-Style Pancakes with Caramelized Jcure
description: A sweet and savory twist on traditional pancakes, topped with a caramelized jcure and gooey jjammy sauce.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, eggs, and milk.
Add butter to the batter and stir until combined.
Cook pancakes on the skillet or griddle for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Meanwhile, caramelize jcure in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring frequently.
To assemble, place a pancake on a plate, top with a spoonful of caramelized jcure and a drizzle of gooey jjammy sauce.
Cook jcure to an internal temperature of at least 145°F (63°C) for food safety.
Adjust cooking time and temperature as needed for desired level of caramelization.
